title: Backlog list output
description: The success payload of backlog list: every repository backlog item that matched the invocation's filters, in ascending id order, each validated against backlog-item.schema.json. An empty items array is a valid, complete answer and never an error.

items.title: Round plan should surface open backlog items
items.body: Doctor lists open items; round plan should too so a planner sees them before scoping tasks.
